content_data.project_title: Regional Enterprise Mobility Solution Expansion Initiative
content_data.project_description: Proposal to expand our mobile-first enterprise solution footprint within the regional automotive sector, focusing on key dealership groups and service networks to drive significant revenue growth and market share.
content_data.timeline: Implementation and ramp-up over the next 18 months, with initial phase completion within 6 months.
objectives: Increase average revenue per user (ARPU) for mobile enterprise clients by 15% through upselling advanced features.
Secure partnerships with at least 5 new large automotive dealership groups within the next 9 months.
Enhance client retention rates for mobile solutions by 10% over the next 18 months.
Achieve a 25% increase in regional mobile solution subscriptions within the next 12 months.
deliverables: Integrated client onboarding and support protocols for new mobile solution deployments.
Pilot program reports for initial key accounts.
revenue_targets: Generate an additional $3.5M in new mobile solution revenue within the first 12 months.
content_data.sales_strategy: Our strategy involves targeted account-based marketing, leveraging existing client relationships for referrals, and offering tailored solution demonstrations. We will focus on value-based selling, emphasizing ROI for automotive clients, and provide ongoing post-sales support to ensure high adoption and satisfaction.

memory_updates.added_item: Achieve a 25% increase in regional mobile solution subscriptions within the next 12 months.
